chunks: From Zurarah, from Abī Jaʿfar عليه السلام, who said:
"The prayer of the two Eids with the Imam is a sunnah (prophetic tradition), and there is no salat (prayer) before them nor after them on that day until zawal (noon)."

key_terms.الزَّوَالِ: zawal, the sun's decline from its zenith around noon
key_terms.الْإِمَامِ: the Imam who leads the Eid prayer
key_terms.الْعِيدَيْنِ: the two Eids, meaning Eid al-Fitr and Eid al-Adha
key_terms.صَلَاةُ: salat (prayer), referring here to the ritual prayer

ai.seo_question: Is there any prayer before or after the Eid prayer with the Imam?
ai.summary: This hadith states the ruling for the salat of the two Eids when performed with the Imam, describing it as a sunnah (prophetic tradition). It also clarifies that on that day there is no salat before or after the Eid prayer until zawal (noon).

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.1454 - From Zurarah, from Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir (as) who said:
"The prayer of the two Eids (Eid al-Fitr and Eid al-Adha) with the Imam is a Sunnah, and there is no prayer before or after them on that day until noon (zawal)."
